book.name: 1 iTimoti
book.title: Afɛ mgbi iPolongwi ababɔ mbi iTimoti

content: Nghanɛ ungwɔ ongwi ababɔ yɔ, n mina gbɛɛ ni abu bibɔ di tɛkyɛ yi angba otaata kpakpa nu Imgbasho ikye ali inggisɛ duu.
Nɛ bibɔ ikye emi utɔ yi ama mfye byito abɔ ma duu adzi ni eyi dzɛ mi iyu yi oshishe oshilididi dafi eyi le sunu Imgbasho di kwakwafɔ esɛ nun nɛni.
Ungwɔnɛ tishi di li ungwɔ okpa Imgbasho ongye Onagbɛ eyi,
ongwu nmina gbɛɛ ni ali inggisɛ duu tu owatɔ-watɔ di ye otsitsi nani.
Bana Imgbasho li onyi ta, inggisɛ oyile inggisɛ gyiide yi Imgbasho kpaa li onyi, li iYesu iKrestu,
nkye ewon nu ikye odulu ali inggisɛ duu watɔ nani. Imgbasho kye ungwɔnɛ tso eyi ngwi onɔ wa gyɔ yɛyɛ mani.
Di li itɔdzɛ nɛ ngwi a dulu ani oli inggisɛ ogbeesɔ di gbikye iYesu, otso Udzengye duu esɔ mgbi oyɛyɛ. N le gbɔ otsitsi, yama li atsika ba.
Nghanɛ ani mina engyulɔ nu ma kyile abɔ mgbi ama osaan mi ali imbe ngwi a to duu bibɔ, no ka li mi itukwu owulu-wulu hona angwodzɛ ba.
Ani di mina gbɛɛ engyaa nu ma mɛ ewo saan, yi ozoyeye no di gyɔgyɔ kpaa. No ka li mi otu omɛɛmɛ mgbi ala hona mi abashi naadi mi ungwɔ ama ofyunfyummya hona tagwude naadi angwuto ofyunfyummya ba,
kpaa no li mi okyɔɔkyɔ osuse ngyɔ mbi engyaa ama nli sunu Imgbasho mani.
Ongyaa no kpayi ungwɔ shilididi yi ewo oyile esɛ mɛnɛmɛnɛ.
Ani nu ongyaa ofɛ otsungwɔ naadi dzɛ yi mfye mi ikye ongyulɔ ba, kpaa no dzɛ shili.
Lubana a teyi mɛ Adan se Ifa.
Li Adan ngwu a kpagyanwo ba, li Ifa ngwu a kpagyanwo di yɛɛ okyɔ obube aali.
Nghaduu engyaa ka watɔ mi onɔ ombimba kini a kiyayi yi oyɛyɛ onuunu yi okpitukwu yi osaan yi okwu blii yɔ.
